parts:
Hi Azadeh, 

Sorry for the long delay!

Just to double check - so, you want to test a model with separate sensitivity to reward and punishment, but with no Pavlovian bias, right? Then, you need to modify its Stan code and run it outside the hBayesDM. You don't have to add your modified model to hBayesDM. 

If it's okay to use the same sensitivity to reward and punishment, you can just use gng_m2: https://github.com/CCS-Lab/hBayesDM/blob/develop/commons/stan_files/gng_m2.stan. 

The "example" data are NOT from the Guitart-Masip study. I believe they are generated from a simulation code. 

Best,
Young
